name: Aston University

facts.text: All of Aston's teaching and recreational facilities are on one self-contained, green 60-acre site at Aston Triangle in Birmingham city centre, with student accommodation on campus run by UNITE.
facts.sourceTitle: Visit Us | Aston University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Birmingham New Street is the nearest railway station to Aston; the nearest tram stops (Bull Street, Corporation Street and Grand Central New Street) are 6-10 minutes away.
facts.sourceTitle: Commuting to university | Aston University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Aston Triangle sits at the heart of Birmingham's Knowledge Quarter and Innovation Precinct.
facts.sourceTitle: Aston Triangle | Aston University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Aston Business School is triple accredited by AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS, a status held by fewer than 1% of business schools worldwide; it gained EQUIS in 1999, AACSB in 2003 and AMBA in 2006.
facts.sourceTitle: Triple Crown accreditation awarded to Aston Business School - Aston University Online (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Aston runs its own pre-CAS interview on Enroly CAS Shield for applicants from listed countries including Nepal; it is a recorded video interview with a 75% pass mark, and applicants who score below that are invited to a 30-minute face-to-face Teams interview with the Visa Compliance Credibility Officers.
facts.sourceTitle: PRE CAS INTERVIEW POLICY (Aston University, v1.8, effective 14 January 2025)

sources.notes: Fetched (PDF text extracted). Verbatim: 'To ensure all students are genuine and credible - coming to the UK to complete their studies'; 'Preparation for students for a UKVI Credibility Interview'; 'We want to know why you are keen to come to the UK and to Aston University'. Recorded interview: 'First step of the process', 'Complete on CAS Shield', 'You will be asked 12 questions plus some administrative checks and questions', 'You do not need your passport', 'Should not take longer than 20-30 minutes', 'Should only be recorded once', 'You will have 7 days from when you are invited to complete the interview'. 'If your recorded interview does not meet the 75% pass you will be invited to a Face-to-Face Interview' - 'a friendly 30-minute interview with the Credibility Team on Microsoft Teams'. Outcome emailed; 48 hours to appeal; no 3rd attempt. Tips: don't take notes or read from a script; use headphones; do your research; it is not a formal interview.

sources.notes: Fetched (PDF text extracted). Key verbatim points: 'The Pre CAS-Questionnaire (CAS Shield) asks certain applicants to answer credibility style questions. If answers are not deemed satisfactory, VCT will request a face-to-face interview.' 'Students from high-risk areas will be picked up automatically by the CAS shield system'; 'The student is given 7 days to complete the interview' plus a 7-day reminder; 'The CAS Shield MyInterview Programme is a video interview platform'; must be completed in a single session; 'All students invited to interview will be asked 14 questions in total ... This includes 10 questions randomly selected from the pre-determined list (1 from each category), 2 administrative questions and 2 random wildcard questions generated from a pre-approved list, none of which are made available to students prior to interview.' 'The questions asked will simulate the same that would be asked during a Home Office Pre-CAS interview.' 'Enroly CAS Shield will select questions at random'. Scored by Enroly or VCT staff within 3-5 working days; pass above 75%, else face-to-face on Teams with the Visa Compliance Credibility Officer, recorded, scored 0-3 per question out of 30: 22+ pass and CAS issued, 21 or below rejected with no CAS. Not attending within 15 minutes = automatic failure. Wildcard example: Q 'Do you have any brothers or sisters', A 'I will be studying in Birmingham' would be marked as a fail with concern over English. Red flags: poor English, looking elsewhere/reading notes, poor research, not providing ID, someone else sitting the interview, lip-syncing, deepfake. Rejected students cannot apply again until the next academic cycle. Appendix A: 'Applications from Nepal' are always invited to a Pre-CAS interview, as are applicants with significant or inconsistent study gaps, previous visa refusals, and non-low-risk applicants studying Business & Management, HRM and International/Global Business.

sources.notes: Fetched. 'As part of the CAS request process, you may be asked to undertake a pre-CAS video interview'.
